neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * We’ve launched **Claude Fable 5.2** (`claude-fable-5-2`), built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. **Claude Mythos 5.2** (`claude-mythos-5-2`) offers the same capabilities only to organizations verified through Anthropic’s verification programs, such as the [Cyber Verification Program](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842). Both models have a [1M token context window](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows), 128k max output tokens, and always-on [adaptive thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking). They cost $8 USD per MTok of input and $40 USD per MTok of output (Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $10 USD per MTok of input and $50 USD per MTok of output). Claude Fable 5.2 is available on the Claude API, [Amazon Bedrock (`bedrock-runtime`)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-on-amazon-bedrock-legacy), [Claude Platform on AWS](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws), [Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-models-on-google-cloud/anthropic-managed), [Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-models-on-google-cloud/google-managed), and [Claude in Microsoft Foundry](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry). See [What’s new in Claude Fable 5.2](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/whats-new-fable-5-2) for API changes and migration guidance. For model-specific prompting patterns, see [Prompting Claude Fable 5.2](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-fable-5-2).

* Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 read other models’ thinking blocks on the Claude API and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed). So on those platforms, a conversation that moves onto either model keeps its reasoning. The other models include Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Haiku 5.5.

* No other model reads thinking blocks from Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2. When a conversation moves from either one to a model outside this pair, the API drops those blocks. That includes a move to Claude Opus 5.5 or Claude Fable 5.1. The request still succeeds. See [Switching models mid-conversation](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking#switching-models).

* [Dreams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams) (research preview) now supports Claude Fable 5.2. See [Supported models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams#feature-availability).
